place.source_title: John North House & Grocery, 514-16 East Pleasant Street

brief: Two-storey frame house-and-grocery: a side-gabled house with a two-tier porch alongside a one-storey shop front that ran as the neighbourhood grocery. Documented in a neighbourhood survey of a working-class district near the factories; several neighbours were boarded when photographed.

facade.notes: the John North House & Grocery (1880): a two-storey frame house with a full porch, and attached at the end a one-storey false-fronted grocery with a display window and double doors on the sidewalk; a fire hydrant at the corner

why.note: the corner grocery attached to the grocer's house: neighbourhood commerce in a residential grid
